LESSON: HOUSE OF GOD

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 5.1: House of God

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on House of God. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is the church a holy place?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate the church as a house of worship

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: HOUSE OF GOD
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 4
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
House of God helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: HOUSE OF GOD
Study House of God like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Appreciate the church as a house of worship

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the church as a house of worship. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the church as a house of worship.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “House of God” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the church as a house of worship. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what House of God is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “House of God” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: appreciate the church as a house of worship)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach House of God to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: appreciate the church as a house of worship.
3. Make one local Kenya example of House of God from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for House of God: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 4 learner study House of God?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is the church a holy place?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what House of God means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: appreciate the church as a house of worship.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
